title: Kinda stuck where to go, what to add to my game. Vibecoded stacking game.
author: FlimsyReality4086
selftext:
Hi there, im looking for feedback and/or tipps what you would like to see in a stacking game.

\- what is good?

\- what is bad?

\- would you feel more engaged if there was a ladder to climb like ranked/weekly highscores?

\- Is intersitial ads after 3 games too much ads - should i tone it down?

\- Music/Events/Sound feedback appreciated

  
You can try it on android here:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.robinschonhardt.stackrush](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.robinschonhardt.stackrush)

  
Thanks a ton for your help. 

Made in Unity - if you have questions regarding the workflow just ask me 😄
